crossRefs.note: and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.

translations.web: and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.
translations.bsb: and that whoever does not fall down and worship will be thrown into the blazing fiery furnace.
translations.kjv: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
translations.asv: and whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
